add: Add an item, such as an option
arrange: Choose how a list is sorted
cancel: Cancel what is under way and put it away
collapse: Return an enlarged view to its usual size
copy: Copy its contents to the clipboard
copy-link: Copy a link to this place
discard: Throw away unsaved edits and stop editing
expand: Show this larger, filling the window
fit: Fit the picture to the space it has
more: Open a menu of more options
next: Go to the next item or step
next-match: Go to the next search match
on-me: Open the list of what waits on you
previous: Go to the previous item or step
previous-match: Go to the previous search match
reset: Return it to its starting state
show: Show where this stands on the page
start: Go back to the first step
suggest: Suggest new wording for the selected words
